_note: Files that live online, written straight into the job: no download step, no setup. A LoRA, a checkpoint and a model can each be an address: hf://owner/repo/path/in/repo or any https:// URL. hf:// reads the repo's main branch; add @revision (hf://owner/repo@<commit>/path) to pin the exact file. For a private or gated Hugging Face repo set HF_TOKEN in .env. On RunPod the pod downloads these files itself; for your own ComfyUI, `jenair pull configs/basics/08-from-url.json` downloads them into the models folder first.

jobs._note: A LoRA by address, here one of Krea's official style LoRAs that is not built in. A LoRA given by address has no engine check and knows no trigger word, so give its `trigger` here.
jobs.name: lora
jobs.prompt: Inside an old glass greenhouse full of ferns and orchids, a watering can on a wooden bench.

jobs._note: A checkpoint by address: an SDXL-type checkpoint (the illustrious engine). Its images go in a folder named after the file: from-url/Illustrious-XL-v1.0/.
jobs.name: checkpoint
jobs.prompt: masterpiece, best quality, 1girl, solo, walking through a sunlit forest, long coat, looking up, leaves falling, soft light

jobs._note: A model as an object, for the engines made of three files (zimage, krea2, qwen, klein): `engine`, the files you replace (`diffusion`, `text_encoder`, `vae`; `checkpoint` for illustrious) as addresses or file names in models/, and `name` for the output folder. Files you leave out are the engine's official ones. A fine-tune usually replaces `diffusion`: "diffusion": "hf://someone/their-finetune/model.safetensors". This example replaces only the small VAE (with the official one, from its address) so that running it does not download a second 12 GB model.
jobs.name: object
jobs.prompt: A quiet neighborhood cafe at dawn, warm light through tall windows, steam rising from a cup on a wooden counter.
